entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
------
Upendra Mahra, aged about 30 years, son of Arjun Mahra @ Arjun Mahara, resident of village-
Jayantigram, P.O. + P.S.- Madhupur, District- Deoghar ... ... Petitioner
-Versus -
The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party

------
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Rahul Ranjan, Advocate For the State : M/s. Shiv Shankar Kumar, A.P.P.
-----
02/10.01.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 97/2023 corresponding to Cyber Crime Case No. 52/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 414,
419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) of the I.P.C. & Sections 66(B), 66(C), 66(D) & 84(C) of the Information Technology Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II,
Deoghar.

3. Bail Application of the petitioner was earlier rejected by this Court vide B.A. No. 1605 of 2024 by order dated 07.05.2024.
4.

On 27.12.2023, at about 9:30 a.m., Cyber Police, Deoghar, on the basis of confidential information, raided a place in village Basbutia and apprehended the petitioner along with other accused persons on suspicion that they were committing cyber-crime.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 5. A mobile phone which was recovered from the possession of the petitioner was used in cheating a victim.
6. It was submitted that the petitioner has remained in custody for more than one year and similarly situated co-accused Siraj Ansari and Sandip Kumar Yadav have been granted bail by this Court.
7. Considering the period of custody, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Deoghar in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 97/2023 corresponding to Cyber Crime Case No. 52/202.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Nandini/-
